name: HEXZA
recent: HEXZA 正在推进 2026 财年末期股息（每股 7.5 仙）的第二次股息再投资计划（DRP），并已获 Bursa 批准最多 2,050 万股再投资股的上市。由于大股东 Foong 家族选择以股代息，持股可能超过 33% 触发强制全面收购，公司因此寻求股东豁免该义务。公司将于 2026 年 11 月 21 日召开第 57 届常年股东大会及特别股东大会。
notable: Bursa 批准第二次股息再投资计划下最多 2,050 万股再投资股的上市。
公司寻求股东豁免 Summit Holdings、Datuk Dr. Foong Weng Sum 及一致行动人因以股代息导致持股超过 33% 而须提出强制全面收购的义务。
第 57 届常年股东大会将于 2026 年 11 月 21 日召开，会上将寻求批准每股 7.5 仙的末期股息。
risks: 大股东因以股代息导致持股超过 33%，若未获股东豁免，可能触发强制全面收购义务。
第二次股息再投资计划将发行最多 2,050 万股新股，可能对现有股东持股产生摊薄效应。

news.title: Hexza Seeks Shareholder Waiver to Let Controlling Family Raise Stake Above 33%
Hexza Seeks Shareholder Approval To Exempt Major Shareholders From Mandatory Takeover
Hexza seeks exemption for Foong family from MGO as dividend reinvestment pushes stake above 33%
Foong family seeks Hexza MGO exemption

recent_en: HEXZA is proceeding with its Second Dividend Reinvestment Plan for the FY2026 final dividend of 7.5 sen per share, with Bursa approving the listing of up to 20.5 million reinvestment shares. As the Foong family's election to receive shares may push their stake above 33% and trigger a mandatory general offer, the company is seeking shareholder exemption from that obligation.
notable_en: Bursa approved the listing of up to 20.5 million reinvestment shares under the Second Dividend Reinvestment Plan.

The company is seeking shareholder exemption for Summit Holdings, Datuk Dr. Foong Weng Sum and persons acting in concert from the mandatory general offer obligation arising from their stake exceeding 33% due to the dividend reinvestment.
The 57th AGM will be held on 21 November 2026, where approval for the final dividend of 7.5 sen per share will be sought.
risks_en: The major shareholders' stake may exceed 33% due to the dividend reinvestment, which could trigger a mandatory general offer obligation if shareholder exemption is not obtained.
The Second Dividend Reinvestment Plan will issue up to 20.5 million new shares, which may dilute existing shareholders' holdings.
